name: HCR Chrome Shop
old_description: From our custom fabricated parts and cost saving wheel polishing to our fully stocked showroom, HCR Chrome Shop keeps your truck looking like new.
about:
HCR Chrome Shop operates in Bangor, Maine, as a local business serving the trucking community. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it presents itself as a dedicated provider of parts, accessories, installation, and cleaning services for commercial rigs.

The shop offers custom fabrication of parts from paintable aluminum and mirror-finish 14-gauge stainless steel, producing items such as custom T-bars, rear center panels, and interior trim pieces. It also runs a wheel polishing machine that restores heavily damaged rims, provides truck washing and interior detailing, installs lighting systems (both stock and custom), and fits chrome accessories. A fully stocked showroom carries a range of in-demand parts, and out-of-stock items can be sourced quickly.

The primary customers are truck drivers and fleets in the commercial transportation sector. The company describes its focus as the "trucking community," offering a one-stop location where drivers can have their rigs washed, polished, detailed, and equipped with chrome or lighting upgrades in a single visit.

HCR Chrome Shop distinguishes itself as "Maine's Only Full-Service Chrome Shop," emphasizing honest, reliable service and a staff willing to go the extra mile. It promotes same-day installation of accessories while wheels are being polished, reducing downtime for drivers. The business was started to give truckers a trustworthy place to get their trucks cleaned up and decked out, with the belief that keeping customers happy is good for business.

about:
HLP Klearfold, headquartered in New York, New York, with a West Coast office in Torrance, California, has been a clear plastic packaging manufacturer for over 50 years. The company operates as a manufacturer of plastic folding cartons, custom thermoformed parts, and clear plastic tubes and rounds.

The company produces plastic folding cartons using proprietary Soft Crease® scoring technology that yields uniform creases for precise folding on automated or hand-filling lines. It also offers custom thermoforming and clear plastic tubes and rounds. Innovations include the patented Klearfold® Keeper packaging system, InSight® visual packaging systems, RPET100 folding cartons made from 100% postconsumer PET, and the Klearfold Keeper CR, a certified child-resistant package. The firm emphasizes global scale and technology investment.

HLP Klearfold serves brands and packagers requiring clear plastic packaging, though specific industries are not detailed in the source material. Its products are used in applications where shelf presence, sustainability, and child resistance are priorities.

The company differentiates itself through its experience, global scale, and commitment to process innovation, including the independently certified 100% postconsumer PET material and proprietary scoring technology.

name: HONYA Lighting
old_description: LED commercial/industrial lighting manufacturer and wholesaler
about:
HONYA Lighting is headquartered in Plainview, New York, on Long Island, with a second operations site in Stafford, Texas. The company was established as a professional LED lighting sales and distribution center serving the New York metropolitan area, the tri-state region, and the broader North American market.

The firm manufactures and wholesales a range of LED commercial and industrial lighting products, including flood lights, area lights, exit signs, T8 tubes, vanity linear lights, surface-mount downlights with motion sensors and emergency backup, and tandem strip fixtures. Its combined inventory facilities total approximately 80,000 square feet, with over 20,000 square feet at the Plainview location. Headcount and annual production volumes are not disclosed.

HONYA serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers across the United States. Its products are specified for projects in the New York tri-state area and are distributed nationally through wholesale channels. The company emphasizes long-term partnerships with electrical contractors, distributors, and facility managers.

The company states that its differentiation rests on delivering sustainable, environmentally progressive lighting solutions built on original product designs. It highlights a quality system certified to TUV‑CE, RoHS, UL, DLC, and ENERGY STAR standards, with strict control from raw materials to finished goods. HONYA also promotes competitive pricing and an experienced team that provides customized, cost‑effective lighting solutions.

name: Hansa Plastics
old_description: Hansa Plastics is committed to providing our customers with the best quality molds at a fair price.
about:
Hansa Plastics was founded in 1959 in Queens, New York, by Peter Schmidt Sr., a master tool maker from Hamburg, Germany. The family-owned business relocated to Kings Park on Long Island's North Shore, where it operates today under the leadership of Schmidt's sons.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding, mold making, and mold design, with expertise in multi-action, hot-runner, 3-plate, two-shot, over-mold, and insert molds. Its Kings Park facility houses injection molding machines ranging from 30 to 385 tons, supported by a full-service mold shop, on-site tool room, and rapid prototyping capabilities. Secondary services include ultrasonic welding, hot stamping, pad printing, 3D printing, assembly, and packaging. Hansa Plastics has produced hundreds of distinct parts over its history.

Hansa Plastics serves a broad range of industries, including aerospace, automotive, communications, electrical, electronics, medical, military, marine, lighting, packaging, and consumer goods such as housewares, hobby products, and small appliances.

The company emphasizes on-time delivery to specification and offers in-house mold repair, refurbishment, or alteration at little or no cost. While most manufacturing is domestic, Hansa Plastics also leverages overseas partners for competitive tooling quotes.

name: Harbor Fab
old_description: Custom commercial and industrial, miscellaneous steel fabrication.
about:
Harbor Fab operates from its headquarters in Benton, Arkansas, with additional production facilities in Winnsboro and Cleburne, Texas, and Baxley, Georgia. The company has been delivering miscellaneous steel fabrication for over 45 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

Harbor Fab specializes in custom commercial and industrial miscellaneous steel fabrication. Across four regional shops totaling more than 125,000 square feet of workshop space, the company produces miscellaneous steel packages of various shapes and sizes. Its capabilities include certified welding and coordinated project management for complex steel assemblies, with nationwide shipping available.

The company serves engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firms, general contractors, and large steel fabricators that require timely delivery of fabricated steel components for commercial and industrial projects.

Harbor Fab emphasizes on-time delivery as a core differentiator, promoting a track record of meeting project deadlines for clients who depend on coordinated fabrication schedules.
